            "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": 0,
            "Tax on LTCG (Other)": 0,
            "Total Tax Before Rebate": 0,
            "Less: Rebate under Section 87A": 0,
            "Tax After Rebate": 0,
            "Surcharge": 0,
            "Health and Education Cess": 0,
            "Total Tax Liability": 0,
            "Less: TDS": 0,
            "Net Tax Payable / Refund": 0
        }
    }

    # Calculate Under Head Salaries
    gross_salary = sum(input_data["Gross Salary"].values())
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Gross Salary"] = gross_salary

    # Calculate exemptions
    hra = input_data["Gross Salary"]["HRA"]
    actual_rent = input_data["Actual Rent Paid"]
    city = input_data["City"]
    if city == "metro":
        exemption_hra = min(hra, actual_rent - (gross_salary * 0.5), actual_rent - 50000)
    else:
        exemption_hra = min(hra, actual_rent - (gross_salary * 0.4), actual_rent - 40000)
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Exemptions"]["Section 10(13A)"] = exemption_hra

    lta_claimed = input_data["LTA Travel Expenses Claimed"]
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Exemptions"]["Section 10(5)"] = lta_claimed

    conveyance = input_data["Gross Salary"]["Conveyance Allowance"]
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Exemptions"]["Section 10(5)"] += conveyance

    # Calculate deductions under Section 16
    professional_tax = input_data["Professional Tax"]
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(ia)"] = professional_tax

    # Standard deduction
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(ii)"] = 50000  # Standard deduction for new regime

    # Calculate Net Salary
    net_salary = gross_salary - (exemption_hra + lta_claimed + conveyance)
    net_salary -= professional_tax
    net_salary -= 50000  # Standard deduction
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Net Salary"] = net_salary

    # Calculate Capital Gains
    for transaction in input_data["Stock Sale Transactions"]:
        sale_price = transaction["Sale Price"]
        cost_price = transaction["Cost Price"]
        quantity = transaction["Quantity"]
        gain = (sale_price - cost_price) * quantity
        if gain > 0:
            output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Section 111A)"] += gain

    # Calculate Income from Other Sources
    output["Income from Other Sources"]["Savings Bank Interest"] = input_data["Savings Bank Interest"]
    output["Income from Other Sources"]["Deposit Interest"] = input_data["Deposit Interest"]
    output["Income from Other Sources"]["Other Interest"] = input_data["Other Interest"]
    output["Income from Other Sources"]["EPF Taxable Interest"] = input_data["EPF Taxable Interest"]

    # Calculate Gross Total Income
    output["Gross Total Income"] = output["Under Head Salaries"]["Net Salary"] + \
                                 output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Section 111A)] + \
                                 output["Income from Other Sources"]["Savings Bank Interest"] + \
                                 output["Income from Other Sources"]["Deposit Interest"] + \
                                 output["Income from Other Sources"]["Other Interest"] + \
                                 output["Income from Other Sources"]["EPF Taxable Interest"]

    # Calculate Deductions
    deductions = output["Deductions"]
    deductions["80C"] = input_data["PPF"] + input_data["ELSS"] + input_data["NPS"]["Tier-1 Self Contribution"]
    deductions["80CCD(1)"] = input_data["NPS"]["Tier-1 Self Contribution"]
    deductions["80CCD(2)"] = input_data["NPS"]["Tier-1 Employer Contribution"]
    deductions["80D"] = sum(hi["Amount"] for hi in input_data["Health Insurance"])
    deductions["80E"] = input_data["Education Loan Interest"]["Interest Paid"]
    deductions["80TTA"] = input_data["Savings Bank Interest"]
    deductions["80TTB"] = 0  # Assuming no senior citizen interest
    deductions["Total Deductions"] = sum(deductions.values())

    # Calculate Total Taxable Income
    output["Total Taxable Income"] = output["Gross Total Income"] - deductions["Total Deductions"]

    # Calculate Tax Computation
    tax_computation = output["Tax Computation"]
    taxable_income = output["Total Taxable Income"]

    # Calculate tax at slab rates
    slab_rates = [0, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3]
    slabs = [300000, 600000, 900000, 1200000, 1500000]
    tax = 0
    remaining = taxable_income
    for i in range(len(slabs)):
        if remaining > slabs[i]:
            tax += (remaining - slabs[i]) * slab_rates[i+1]
            remaining = slabs[i]
        else:
            tax += remaining * slab_rates[i+1]
            break
    tax_computation["Tax at Slab Rates"] = tax

    # Calculate other taxes on capital gains
    tax_computation["Tax on STCG (Section 111A)"] = output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Section 111A)"] * 0.15
    tax_computation["Tax on STCG (Other)"] = output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Other)"]["Total"] * 0.15
    tax_computation["Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)"] = output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Section 112A)"] * 0.1
    tax_computation["Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)"] = output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Non-Equity)"]["Total"] * 0.2
    tax_computation["Tax on LTCG (Other)"] = output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Other)"] * 0.2

    # Calculate total tax before rebate
    tax_computation["Total Tax Before Rebate"] = tax_computation["Tax at Slab Rates"] + \
                                              tax_computation["Tax on STCG (Section 111A)"] + \
                                              tax_computation["Tax on STCG (Other)"] + \
                                              tax_computation["Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)"] + \
                                              tax_computation["Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)"] + \
                                              tax_computation["Tax on LTCG (Other)"]

    # Calculate rebate under Section 87A
    if taxable_income <= 500000:
        rebate = min(10000, tax_computation["Total Tax Before Rebate"])
    else:
        rebate = 0
    tax_computation["Less: Rebate under Section 87A"] = rebate

    # Calculate tax after rebate
    tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] = tax_computation["Total Tax Before Rebate"] - rebate

    # Calculate surcharge and cess
    if tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] > 0:
        surcharge = 0
        if tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] > 10000000:
            surcharge = (tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] - 10000000) * 0.25
        elif tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] > 5000000:
            surcharge = (tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] - 5000000) * 0.15
        elif tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] > 2500000:
            surcharge = (tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] - 2500000) * 0.1
        tax_computation["Surcharge"] = surcharge
        tax_computation["Health and Education Cess"] = tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] * 0.04
    else:
        tax_computation["Surcharge"] = 0
        tax_computation["Health and Education Cess"] = 0

    # Calculate total tax liability
    tax_computation["Total Tax Liability"] = tax_computation["Tax After Rebate"] + \
                                          tax_computation["Surcharge"] + \
                                          tax_computation["Health and Education Cess"]

    # Subtract TDS
    tax_computation["Less: TDS"] = input_data["TDS"]
    tax_computation["Net Tax Payable / Refund"] = tax_computation["Total Tax Liability"] - input_data["TDS"]

    return output

def main():

        input_data = json.load(f)
    output = calculate_tax(input_data)
    print(json.dumps(output))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    under_salaries = {
        "Gross Salary": gross_salary,

        if transaction['Sale Date'] <= transaction['Purchase Date'] + 12 months:
            # Short-term gain
            stcg_section_111a += gain

            # Long-term gain
            ltcg_section_112a += gain

    for mf in input_data['Mutual Fund Transactions']:

            purchase_value = mf['Purchase Value']
            sale_value = mf['Sale Value']

            if mf['Sale Date'] <= mf['Purchase Date'] + 3 years:
                # Short-term gain
                stcg_other['Mutual Funds'] += gain
            else:
                # Long-term gain
                ltcg_non_equity['Mutual Funds'] += gain
    
    capital_gains = {
        "STCG (Section 111A)": stcg_section_111a,

        "Deposit Interest": input_data['Deposit Interest'],
        "Other Interest": input_data['Other Interest'],
        "EPF Taxable Interest": input_data['EPF Taxable Interest']
    }
    total_other_sources = sum(other_sources.values())
    
    # Gross Total Income
    gross_total_income = under_salaries['Net Salary'] + capital_gains['STCG (Section 111A)] + \
                        capital_gains['LTCG (Section 112A)] + total_other_sources
    
    # Deductions
    deductions = {
        "80C": 0,
        "80CCC": 0,
        "80CCD(1)": 0,
        "80CCD(1B)": 0,
        "80CCD(2)": 0,

        "80TTA": 0,
        "80TTB": 0,
        "Total Deductions": 0
    }

    deductions['80CCD(1B')] = input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Self Contribution']
    deductions['80CCD(2')] = input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Employer Contribution']
    deductions['80D'] = input_data['Health Insurance'][0]['Amount']
    deductions['80E'] = input_data['Education Loan Interest']['Interest Paid']
    deductions['80G'] = input_data['Donations'][0]['Amount'] * 0.5  # 50% deduction
    deductions['80TTA'] = min(input_data['Savings Bank Interest'], 10000)
    
    deductions['Total Deductions'] = sum(deductions.values())
    
    # Tax Computation
    taxable_income = gross_total_income - deductions['Total Deductions']
    
    # Calculate tax at slab rates
    tax_slabs = [
        (300000, 0.05),
        (300000, 0.10),  # 3-6 lakh
        (300000, 0.15),  # 6-9 lakh
        (300000, 0.20),  # 9-12 lakh
        (300000, 0.25),  # 12-15 lakh
        (None, 0.30)     # Above 15 lakh
    ]
    
    tax_at_slab = 0
    remaining_income = taxable_income
    for slab, rate in tax_slabs:
        if remaining_income <= 0:
            break
        if slab is None:
            tax_at_slab += remaining_income * rate
        else:
            taxable = min(remaining_income, slab)
            tax_at_slab += taxable * rate

    tax_stcg_other = sum(stcg_other.values()) * 0.15 if sum(stcg_other.values()) > 0 else 0

    # Rebate under Section 87A
    rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, 12500) if taxable_income <= 500000 else 0
    
    # Surcharge and Cess
    if taxable_income > 5000000:
        surcharge = 0.10 * total_tax_before_rebate
    else:
        surcharge = 0
        
    health_education_cess = total_tax_before_rebate * 0.04
    
    total_tax_liability = total_tax_before_rebate - rebate + surcharge + health_education_cess
    
    # Net tax payable
    net_tax_payable = max(total_tax_liability - input_data['TDS'], 0)

        "Surcharge": surcharge,

        "Total Tax Liability": total_tax_liability,
        "Less: TDS": input_data['TDS'],
        "Net Tax Payable / Refund": net_tax_payable
    }
    
    # Construct final output
    output = {
        "Under Head Salaries": under_salaries,
        "Capital Gains": capital_gains,
        "Income from Other Sources": other_sources,
        "Gross Total Income": gross_total_income,
        "Deductions": deductions,
        "Total Taxable Income": taxable_income,
        "Tax Computation": tax_computation
    }
    
    return output

    # Exemptions
    hra_exemption = min(
        input_data['Gross Salary']['HRA'],
        input_data['Actual Rent Paid'] - 0.1 * input_data['Gross Salary']['Basic Salary'],
        0.5 * input_data['Gross Salary']['Basic Salary'] if input_data['City'] == 'metro' else 0.4 * input_data['Gross Salary']['Basic Salary']
    )

    lta_exemption = input_data['LTA Travel Expenses Claimed']
    medical_exemption = input_data['Gross Salary']['Medical Allowance']

    section_10_5 = conveyance_exemption + lta_exemption + medical_exemption

    section_16_ii = input_data['Gross Salary']['Entertainment Allowance']
    section_16_iii = input_data['Professional Tax']

    for transaction in input_data['Stock Sale Transactions']:

        purchase_date = datetime.strptime(transaction['Purchase Date'], '%Y-%m-%d')
        days_held = (sale_date - purchase_date).days
        
        if days_held < 365:
            # STCG
            gain = (transaction['Sale Price'] - transaction['Cost Price']) * transaction['Quantity']
            brokerage_stt = transaction['Brokerage'] + transaction['STT']
            stcg = gain - brokerage_stt
            stcg_section_111a += stcg
        else:
            # LTCG
            if transaction['FMV as of 31 Jan 2018']:
                gain = (transaction['Sale Price'] - max(transaction['Cost Price'], transaction['FMV as of 31 Jan 2018'])) * transaction['Quantity']
            else:
                gain = (transaction['Sale Price'] - transaction['Cost Price']) * transaction['Quantity']
            brokerage_stt = transaction['Brokerage'] + transaction['STT']
            ltcg = gain - brokerage_stt
            ltcg_section_112a += ltcg
    
    for loss in input_data['Short Term Capital Loss']:

    for transaction in input_data['Mutual Fund Transactions']:

        else:

            if transaction['Type'] == 'equity':

    ]

        if remaining_income <= 0:

    slabs = [
        (0, 300000, 0),
        (300001, 600000, 0.10),
        (600001, 1200000, 0.20),
        (1200001, 1500000, 0.25),
        (1500001, float('inf'), 0.30)
    ]
    tax = 0
    remaining = income
    for slab in slabs:
        lower, upper, rate = slab
        taxable = min(upper - lower, remaining)
        if taxable < 0:
            break
        tax += taxable * rate
        remaining -= taxable
    return tax

    output["Tax Computation"]["Tax on LTCG (Other)"] = output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Other)"] * 0.20

    output["Tax Computation"]["Total Tax Liability"] = total_tax_liability

    output["Tax Computation"]["Net Tax Payable / Refund"] = total_tax_liability - input_data["TDS"]

        }

    gross_salary = sum(input_data["Gross Salary"].values())

    # Calculate exemptions
    hra_exemption = min(
        input_data["Gross Salary"]["HRA"],
        input_data["Actual Rent Paid"] - (0.5 * input_data["Gross Salary"]["Basic Salary"]),
        input_data["Gross Salary"]["HRA"]
    )
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Exemptions"]["Section 10(13A)"] = hra_exemption
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Exemptions"]["Section 10(5)"] = input_data["LTA Travel Expenses Claimed"]

    # Calculate deductions under Section 16
    section_16_ia = input_data["Professional Tax"]
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(ia)"] = section_16_ia
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(ii)"] = 0  # Not applicable under new tax regime
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(iii)"] = 0  # Not applicable under new tax regime

    net_salary = (gross_salary - 
                  sum(output["Under Head Salaries"]["Exemptions"].values()) - 
                  sum([section_16_ia, 
                       output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(ii)"], 
                       output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(iii)"]]))
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Net Salary"] = net_salary

    # Calculate Capital Gains
    for transaction in input_data["Stock Sale Transactions"]:
        sale_price = transaction["Sale Price"]
        cost_price = transaction["Cost Price"]
        quantity = transaction["Quantity"]
        brokerage = transaction["Brokerage"]
        stt = transaction["STT"]

        if (transaction["Sale Date"] <= 
            (transaction["Purchase Date"] + 
             (transaction["Purchase Date"].offset('P1Y') - 
              transaction["Purchase Date"]))) :
            # Short term gain
            output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Section 111A)"] += gain
        else:
            # Long term gain
            output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Section 112A)"] += gain

                  input_data["ELSS"] + 
                  input_data["EPF"]["Employee Contribution"]["Deducted from Salary"] +

    output["Deductions"]["80C"] = min(section_80c, 150000)

    for insurance in input_data["Health Insurance"]:

    # Section 80TTB
    output["Deductions"]["80TTB"] = input_data["Deposit Interest"]

    output["Deductions"]["Total Deductions"] = sum(output["Deductions"].values())

    tax_slabs = [
        (0, 300000, 0),
        (300001, 600000, 0.1),
        (600001, 1200000, 0.15),
        (1200001, 1500000, 0.20),
        (1500001, 2500000, 0.25),
        (2500001, float('inf'), 0.30)
    ]

    taxable_income = output["Total Taxable Income"]

        taxable_in_slab = min(upper, taxable_income) - lower
        if taxable_in_slab > 0:

    output["Tax Computation"]["Tax at Slab Rates"] = tax_at_slab_rates

    # Calculate other taxes on capital gains
    output["Tax Computation"]["Tax on STCG (Section 111A)"] = output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Section 111A)"] * 0.15

                              output["Tax Computation"]["Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)"] + 
                              output["Tax Computation"]["Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)"])

    rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, 12500) if taxable_income <= 500000 else 0
    output["Tax Computation"]["Less: Rebate under Section 87A"] = rebate

    tax_after_rebate = total_tax_before_rebate - rebate
    output["Tax Computation"]["Tax After Rebate"] = tax_after_rebate

    # Calculate surcharge
    if taxable_income > 5000000:
        surcharge = 0.25 * tax_after_rebate
    elif taxable_income > 2500000:
        surcharge = 0.15 * tax_after_rebate
    elif taxable_income > 1000000:

    output["Tax Computation"]["Less: TDS"] = input_data["TDS"]
    output["Tax Computation"]["Net Tax Payable / Refund"] = total_tax_liability - input_data["TDS"]

    return output

import json

def calculate_tax(input_data):
    # Under Head Salaries
    gross_salary = sum(input_data['Gross Salary'].values())
    
    # Exemptions
    hra_exemption = min(
        input_data['Actual Rent Paid'],
        input_data['Gross Salary']['HRA'],
        (0.4 * input_data['Gross Salary']['Basic Salary'])
    )
    lta_exemption = input_data['LTA Travel Expenses Claimed']
    conveyance_exemption = input_data['Gross Salary']['Conveyance Allowance']
    exemptions = {
        'Section 10(13A)': hra_exemption,
        'Section 10(5)': lta_exemption
    }
    
    # Deductions under Section 16
    section_16 = {
        'Section 16(ia)': input_data['Professional Tax'],
        'Section 16(ii)': 0,
        'Section 16(iii)': 0
    }
    
    net_salary = gross_salary - sum(exemptions.values()) - sum(section_16.values())
    
    under_salaries = {
        'Gross Salary': gross_salary,
        'Exemptions': exemptions,
        'Section 16(ia)': section_16['Section 16(ia)'],
        'Section 16(ii)': section_16['Section 16(ii)'],
        'Section 16(iii)': section_16['Section 16(iii)'],
        'Net Salary': net_salary
    }
    
    # Capital Gains
    def calculate_capital_gains(transactions, is_long_term):
        gains = []
        for tx in transactions:
            sale_price = tx['Sale Price'] * tx['Quantity']
            cost_price = tx['Cost Price'] * tx['Quantity']
            brokerage = tx['Brokerage']
            stt = tx['STT']
            gain = sale_price - cost_price - brokerage - stt
            if gain > 0:
                gains.append(gain)
        return sum(gains)
    
    stock_gains = []
    for stock in input_data['Stock Sale Transactions']:
        if (days_between(stock['Purchase Date'], stock['Sale Date']) < 365):
            stock_gains.append(calculate_capital_gains([stock], False))
    
    mutual_fund_gains = []
    for mf in input_data['Mutual Fund Transactions']:
        if mf['Type'] in ['equity', 'elss']:
            if days_between(mf['Purchase Date'], mf['Sale Date']) < 365:
                mutual_fund_gains.append(mf['Sale Value'] - mf['Purchase Value'])
    
    stcg_section_111a = sum(stock_gains) if stock_gains else 0
    stcg_other = {
        'Bonds': 0,
        'Debentures': 0,
        'G-Secs': 0,
        'Mutual Funds': sum(mutual_fund_gains) if mutual_fund_gains else 0,
        'Total': sum(mutual_fund_gains) if mutual_fund_gains else 0
    }
    
    ltcg_section_112a = 0
    ltcg_non_equity = {
        'Bonds': 0,
        'Debentures': 0,
        'G-Secs': 0,
        'Mutual Funds': 0,
        'Total': 0
    }
    ltcg_other = 0
    
    capital_gains = {
        'STCG (Section 111A)': stcg_section_111a,
        'STCG (Other)': stcg_other,
        'LTCG (Section 112A)': ltcg_section_112a,
        'LTCG (Non-Equity)': ltcg_non_equity,
        'LTCG (Other)': ltcg_other
    }
    
    # Income from Other Sources
    other_sources = {
        'Savings Bank Interest': input_data['Savings Bank Interest'],
        'Deposit Interest': input_data['Deposit Interest'],
        'Other Interest': input_data['Other Interest'],
        'EPF Taxable Interest': input_data['EPF Taxable Interest']
    }
    
    # Gross Total Income
    gross_total_income = under_salaries['Net Salary'] + sum(other_sources.values()) + \
                        capital_gains['STCG (Section 111A')] + capital_gains['STCG (Other)']['Total'] + \
                        capital_gains['LTCG (Section 112A')] + capital_gains['LTCG (Non-Equity)']['Total'] + \
                        capital_gains['LTCG (Other)']
    
    # Deductions
    deductions = {
        '80C': input_data['PPF'] + input_data['ELSS'] + input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Self Contribution'],
        '80CCC': 0,
        '80CCD(1)': 0.1 * (input_data['EPF']['Employee Contribution']['Deducted from Salary'] + 
                           input_data['EPF']['Employee Contribution']['Voluntary']),
        '80CCD(1B)': input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Self Contribution'],
        '80CCD(2)': input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Employer Contribution'],
        '80D': 0,
        '80E': input_data['Education Loan Interest']['Interest Paid'],
        '80G': sum(d['Amount'] for d in input_data['Donations']) * 0.5,
        '80TTA': input_data['Savings Bank Interest'],
        '80TTB': 0,
        'Total Deductions': sum(deductions.values())
    }
    
    # Tax Computation
    taxable_income = gross_total_income - deductions['Total Deductions']
    
    # Calculate tax at slab rates
    slab_rates = [0, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3]
    slabs = [300000, 1200000, 1500000, 2500000, None]
    tax_at_slabs = 0
    remaining_income = taxable_income
    for i in range(len(slabs)):
        if i == 0:
            taxable = min(remaining_income, slabs[i])
        else:
            taxable = min(remaining_income, slabs[i] - slabs[i-1])
        tax_at_slabs += taxable * slab_rates[i]
        remaining_income -= taxable
        if remaining_income <= 0:
            break
    
    tax_on_stcg_111a = stcg_section_111a * 0.15
    tax_on_stcg_other = stcg_other['Total'] * 0.15
    tax_on_ltcg_112a = ltcg_section_112a * 0.1
    tax_on_ltcg_non_equity = ltcg_non_equity['Total'] * 0.2
    
    total_tax_before_rebate = tax_at_slabs + tax_on_stcg_111a + tax_on_stcg_other + \
                              tax_on_ltcg_112a + tax_on_ltcg_non_equity
    
    rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, 12500) if taxable_income <= 500000 else 0
    
    tax_after_rebate = total_tax_before_rebate - rebate
    
    surcharge = 0
    if taxable_income > 5000000:
        surcharge = 0.1 * tax_after_rebate
    elif taxable_income > 2000000:
        surcharge = 0.05 * tax_after_rebate
    
    health_education_cess = tax_after_rebate * 0.04
    
    total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + health_education_cess
    
    net_tax_payable = max(0, total_tax_liability - input_data['TDS'])
    
    tax_computation = {
        'Tax at Slab Rates': tax_at_slabs,
        'Tax on STCG (Section 111A)': tax_on_stcg_111a,
        'Tax on STCG (Other)': tax_on_stcg_other,
        'Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)': tax_on_ltcg_112a,
        'Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)': tax_on_ltcg_non_equity,
        'Tax on LTCG (Other)': 0,
        'Total Tax Before Rebate': total_tax_before_rebate,
        'Less: Rebate under Section 87A': rebate,
        'Tax After Rebate': tax_after_rebate,
        'Surcharge': surcharge,
        'Health and Education Cess': health_education_cess,
        'Total Tax Liability': total_tax_liability,
        'Less: TDS': input_data['TDS'],
        'Net Tax Payable / Refund': net_tax_payable
    }
    
    # Construct final output
    output = {
        'Under Head Salaries': under_salaries,
        'Capital Gains': capital_gains,
        'Income from Other Sources': other_sources,
        'Gross Total Income': gross_total_income,
        'Deductions': deductions,
        'Total Taxable Income': taxable_income,
        'Tax Computation': tax_computation
    }
    
    return output

def days_between(start, end):
    from datetime import datetime
    start_date = datetime.strptime(start, '%Y-%m-%d')
    end_date = datetime.strptime(end, '%Y-%m-%d')
    return (end_date - start_date).days

def main():
    with open('input.json', 'r') as f:
        input_data = json.load(f)
    output = calculate_tax(input_data)
    print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import json

def calculate_tax(input_data):
    # Under Head Salaries
    gross_salary = sum(input_data['Gross Salary'].values())
    hra_exemption = min(
        input_data['Actual Rent Paid'],
        input_data['Gross Salary']['HRA'],
        0.5 * input_data['Gross Salary']['Basic Salary']
    )
    lta_exemption = input_data['LTA Travel Expenses Claimed']
    section_10_exemptions = hra_exemption + lta_exemption
    section_16_ia = input_data['Professional Tax']
    section_16_ii = 0  # Not applicable for private sector
    section_16_iii = 0  # Not applicable for private sector
    net_salary = gross_salary - section_10_exemptions - section_16_ia - section_16_ii - section_16_iii

    # Capital Gains
    stcg_section_111a = 0
    stcg_other = {'Bonds': 0, 'Debentures': 0, 'G-Secs': 0, 'Mutual Funds': 0, 'Total': 0}
    ltcg_section_112a = 0
    ltcg_non_equity = {'Bonds': 0, 'Debentures': 0, 'G-Secs': 0, 'Mutual Funds': 0, 'Total': 0}
    ltcg_other = 0

    for transaction in input_data['Stock Sale Transactions']:
        quantity = transaction['Quantity']
        sale_price = transaction['Sale Price']
        cost_price = transaction['Cost Price']
        brokerage = transaction['Brokerage']
        stt = transaction['STT']
        gain_per_share = sale_price - cost_price - brokerage/quantity - stt/quantity
        total_gain = gain_per_share * quantity
        if transaction['Sale Date'] > transaction['Purchase Date'] + 365:
            # LTCG
            ltcg_other += total_gain
        else:
            # STCG
            stcg_section_111a += total_gain

    for transaction in input_data['Mutual Fund Transactions']:
        purchase_value = transaction['Purchase Value']
        sale_value = transaction['Sale Value']
        if transaction['Sale Date'] > transaction['Purchase Date'] + 365:
            # LTCG
            ltcg_non_equity['Mutual Funds'] += sale_value - purchase_value
        else:
            # STCG
            stcg_other['Mutual Funds'] += sale_value - purchase_value

    vehicle_gain = input_data['Privately Owned Vehicle']['Sale Amount'] - input_data['Privately Owned Vehicle']['Purchase Amount']
    ltcg_other += vehicle_gain

    bonds_gain = input_data['Bonds']['Sale Amount'] - input_data['Bonds']['Purchase Amount']
    debentures_gain = input_data['Debentures']['Sale Amount'] - input_data['Debentures']['Purchase Amount']
    gsecs_gain = input_data['G-Secs']['Sale Amount'] - input_data['G-Secs']['Purchase Amount']
    ltcg_non_equity['Bonds'] += bonds_gain
    ltcg_non_equity['Debentures'] += debentures_gain
    ltcg_non_equity['G-Secs'] += gsecs_gain

    ltcg_non_equity['Total'] = sum(ltcg_non_equity.values())
    stcg_other['Total'] = sum(stcg_other.values())

    # Applying capital losses
    long_term_losses = sum(loss['Loss Amount'] for loss in input_data['Long Term Capital Loss'])
    short_term_losses = sum(loss['Loss Amount'] for loss in input_data['Short Term Capital Loss'])

    ltcg_other -= long_term_losses
    stcg_section_111a -= short_term_losses

    # Income from Other Sources
    savings_interest = input_data['Savings Bank Interest']
    deposit_interest = input_data['Deposit Interest']
    other_interest = input_data['Other Interest']
    epf_interest = input_data['EPF Taxable Interest']

    # Deductions
    deductions = {
        '80C': 0,
        '80CCC': 0,
        '80CCD(1)': input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Self Contribution'],
        '80CCD(1B)': 0,
        '80CCD(2)': input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Employer Contribution'],
        '80D': 0,
        '80E': input_data['Education Loan Interest']['Interest Paid'],
        '80G': sum(donation['Amount'] for donation in input_data['Donations']),
        '80TTA': savings_interest,
        '80TTB': 0,
        'Total Deductions': 0
    }

    health_premiums = sum(policy['Amount'] for policy in input_data['Health Insurance'])
    deductions['80D'] = health_premiums

    ppf = input_data['PPF']
    elss = input_data['ELSS']
    pension = input_data['Pension Scheme Premium']['Amount']
    nps = input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Self Contribution'] + input_data['NPS']['Tier-2']
    deductions['80C'] = ppf + elss + pension + nps

    deductions['Total Deductions'] = sum(deductions.values())

    # Gross Total Income
    gross_total_income = net_salary + stcg_section_111a + stcg_other['Total'] + ltcg_section_112a + \
                        ltcg_non_equity['Total'] + ltcg_other + savings_interest + deposit_interest + \
                        other_interest + epf_interest

    # Tax Computation
    taxable_income = gross_total_income - deductions['Total Deductions']

    # Calculate tax at slab rates
    slab_rates = [0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3]
    slabs = [300000, 1200000, 10000000, float('inf')]
    tax_at_slabs = 0
    remaining_income = taxable_income
    for i in range(len(slabs)):
        if remaining_income > slabs[i]:
            taxable_in_slab = min(remaining_income - slabs[i], slabs[i+1] - slabs[i] if i+1 < len(slabs) else remaining_income)
            tax_at_slabs += taxable_in_slab * slab_rates[i]
            remaining_income -= taxable_in_slab
        else:
            break

    tax_on_stcg_111a = stcg_section_111a * 0.15
    tax_on_stcg_other = stcg_other['Total'] * 0.15
    tax_on_ltcg_112a = ltcg_section_112a * 0.1
    tax_on_ltcg_non_equity = ltcg_non_equity['Total'] * 0.2
    tax_on_ltcg_other = ltcg_other * 0.2

    total_tax_before_rebate = tax_at_slabs + tax_on_stcg_111a + tax_on_stcg_other + tax_on_ltcg_112a + tax_on_ltcg_non_equity + tax_on_ltcg_other

    rebate = 12500 if taxable_income <= 1500000 else 0

    tax_after_rebate = total_tax_before_rebate - rebate
    if tax_after_rebate < 0:
        tax_after_rebate = 0

    surcharge = 0.1 * total_tax_before_rebate
    health_education_cess = 0.04 * total_tax_before_rebate

    total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + health_education_cess

    net_tax_payable = max(0, total_tax_liability - input_data['TDS'])

    return {

            "Gross Salary": gross_salary,
            "Exemptions": {
                "Section 10(13A)": hra_exemption,
                "Section 10(5)": lta_exemption
            },

            "Section 16(ii)": section_16_ii,
            "Section 16(iii)": section_16_iii,
            "Net Salary": net_salary
        },

            "STCG (Section 111A)": stcg_section_111a,
            "STCG (Other)": stcg_other,
            "LTCG (Section 112A)": ltcg_section_112a,
            "LTCG (Non-Equity)": ltcg_non_equity,
            "LTCG (Other)": ltcg_other
        },
        "Income from Other Sources": {
            "Savings Bank Interest": savings_interest,
            "Deposit Interest": deposit_interest,
            "Other Interest": other_interest,
            "EPF Taxable Interest": epf_interest
        },
        "Gross Total Income": gross_total_income,
        "Deductions": deductions,
        "Total Taxable Income": taxable_income,
        "Tax Computation": {
            "Tax at Slab Rates": tax_at_slabs,
            "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": tax_on_stcg_111a,
            "Tax on STCG (Other)": tax_on_stcg_other,
            "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": tax_on_ltcg_112a,
            "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": tax_on_ltcg_non_equity,
            "Tax on LTCG (Other)": tax_on_ltcg_other,
            "Total Tax Before Rebate": total_tax_before_rebate,
            "Less: Rebate under Section 87A": rebate,
            "Tax After Rebate": tax_after_rebate,
            "Surcharge": surcharge,
            "Health and Education Cess": health_education_cess,
            "Total Tax Liability": total_tax_liability,
            "Less: TDS": input_data['TDS'],
            "Net Tax Payable / Refund": net_tax_payable
        }
    }

def main():

        },

        "Tax Computation": {

    # Calculate Under Head Salaries

    basic = input_data["Gross Salary"]["Basic Salary"]

    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(iii)"] = 0  # Not applicable under new regime

    # Net Salary
    net_salary = gross_salary - (
        hra_exemption + lta_claimed + 
        output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(ia)"] + 
        output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(ii)"] + 
        output["Under Head Salaries"]["Section 16(iii)"]
    )
    output["Under Head Salaries"]["Net Salary"] = net_salary

    def calculate_stcg_ltcg(transactions, is_stock):

        for tx in transactions:

            cost_price = tx["Cost Price"] * tx["Quantity"]
            gain = sale_price - cost_price
            if gain > 0:
                if is_stock:
                    holding_years = (tx["Sale Date"] - tx["Purchase Date"]).days / 365
                    if holding_years < 1:
                        gains.append({"type": "STCG", "amount": gain})
                    else:
                        gains.append({"type": "LTCG", "amount": gain})
                else:
                    gains.append({"type": "STCG", "amount": gain})
        return gains

    stock_transactions = input_data["Stock Sale Transactions"]
    stock_gains = calculate_stcg_ltcg(stock_transactions, is_stock=True)
    
    mutual_fund_transactions = input_data["Mutual Fund Transactions"]
    mutual_fund_gains = calculate_stcg_ltcg(mutual_fund_transactions, is_stock=False)

    total_stcg_111a = sum(g["amount"] for g in stock_gains if g["type"] == "STCG")
    output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Section 111A)"] = total_stcg_111a

    # Other STCG (non-section 111A)
    other_stcg = sum(g["amount"] for g in mutual_fund_gains if g["type"] == "STCG")
    output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Other)"]["Mutual Funds"] = other_stcg
    output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Other)"]["Total"] = other_stcg

    output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Non-Equity)"]["Total"] = ltcg_non_equity

    output["Income from Other Sources"]["Deposit Interest"] = input_data["Deposit Interest"]
    output["Income from Other Sources"]["Other Interest"] = input_data["Other Interest"]
    output["Income from Other Sources"]["EPF Taxable Interest"] = input_data["EPF Taxable Interest"]

    output["Gross Total Income"] = (

        output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Section 111A)"] + 
        output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Other)"]["Total"] +
        output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Section 112A)"] +
        output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Non-Equity)"]["Total"] +
        output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Other)"] +
        sum(output["Income from Other Sources"].values())
    )

        deductions = {
            "80C": 0,
            "80CCC": 0,
            "80CCD(1)": 0,
            "80CCD(1B)": 0,
            "80CCD(2)": 0,
            "80D": 0,
            "80E": 0,
            "80G": 0,
            "80TTA": 0,
            "80TTB": 0,
            "Total Deductions": 0
        }

        # 80C: PPF, ELSS, etc.
        deductions["80C"] = (
            input_data["PPF"] + 
            input_data["ELSS"] + 
            input_data["NPS"]["Tier-1 Self Contribution"] + 
            input_data["NPS"]["Tier-1 Employer Contribution"]
        )

        # 80D: Health Insurance
        health_insurance = sum(hi["Amount"] for hi in input_data["Health Insurance"])
        deductions["80D"] = health_insurance

        # 80E: Education Loan Interest
        deductions["80E"] = input_data["Education Loan Interest"]["Interest Paid"]

        # 80G: Donations
        donations = sum(d["Amount"] for d in input_data["Donations"])
        deductions["80G"] = donations

        # 80TTA: Savings Bank Interest
        deductions["80TTA"] = input_data["Savings Bank Interest"]

        # 80TTB: Deposit Interest
        deductions["80TTB"] = input_data["Deposit Interest"]

        deductions["Total Deductions"] = sum(deductions.values())
        return deductions

    output["Deductions"] = calculate_deductions(input_data)

    # Tax Computation
    def compute_tax(gross_income, deductions, tds):
        taxable_income = gross_income - deductions["Total Deductions"]
        if taxable_income < 0:
            taxable_income = 0

        # Tax slabs for FY 2025-26 (New Regime)
        slabs = [
            (0, 300000, 0),
            (300000, 600000, 0.10),
            (600000, 1200000, 0.15),
            (1200000, 1800000, 0.20),
            (1800000, 2500000, 0.25),
            (2500000, 5000000, 0.30),
            (5000000, float('inf'), 0.30)
        ]

        tax_at_slabs = 0
        taxable = taxable_income
        for slab in slabs:
            lower, upper, rate = slab
            taxable_in_slab = min(upper - lower, taxable - lower)
            if taxable_in_slab < 0:
                continue
            tax_at_slabs += taxable_in_slab * rate

        # Calculate tax on STCG (Section 111A)
        stcg_111a = output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Section 111A)"]
        tax_stcg_111a = stcg_111a * 0.15

        # Calculate tax on STCG (Other)
        stcg_other = output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Other)"]["Total"]
        tax_stcg_other = stcg_other * 0.15

        # Calculate tax on LTCG (Section 112A)
        ltcg_112a = output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Section 112A)"]
        tax_ltcg_112a = ltcg_112a * 0.10

        # Calculate tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)
        ltcg_non_equity = output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Non-Equity)"]["Total"]
        tax_ltcg_non_equity = ltcg_non_equity * 0.20

        total_tax_before_rebate = (
            tax_at_slabs + 
            tax_stcg_111a + 
            tax_stcg_other + 
            tax_ltcg_112a + 
            tax_ltcg_non_equity
        )

        # Rebate under Section 87A
        rebate = 12500 if taxable_income <= 1875000 else 0

        tax_after_rebate = max(0, total_tax_before_rebate - rebate)

        # Surcharge calculation
        surcharge = 0
        if taxable_income > 5000000:
            surcharge = 0.25 * (taxable_income - 5000000)
        elif taxable_income > 2500000:
            surcharge = 0.10 * (taxable_income - 2500000)
        elif taxable_income > 1000000:
            surcharge = 0.15 * (taxable_income - 1000000)

        # Health and Education Cess
        cess = (total_tax_before_rebate + surcharge) * 0.04

        total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + cess

        net_tax_payable = max(0, total_tax_liability - tds)

        return {
            "Tax at Slab Rates": tax_at_slabs,
            "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": tax_stcg_111a,
            "Tax on STCG (Other)": tax_stcg_other,
            "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": tax_ltcg_112a,
            "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": tax_ltcg_non_equity,
            "Total Tax Before Rebate": total_tax_before_rebate,
            "Less: Rebate under Section 87A": rebate,
            "Tax After Rebate": tax_after_rebate,
            "Surcharge": surcharge,
            "Health and Education Cess": cess,
            "Total Tax Liability": total_tax_liability,
            "Less: TDS": tds,
            "Net Tax Payable / Refund": net_tax_payable
        }

    tax_computation = compute_tax(
        output["Gross Total Income"],
        output["Deductions"],
        input_data["TDS"]
    )
    output["Tax Computation"] = tax_computation

    return output

def main():
    with open('input.json', 'r') as f:
        input_data = json.load(f)
    output = calculate_tax(input_data)
    print(json.dumps(output))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            gain = sale_price - cost_price
            if gain > 0:

                    else:

            "80CCD(2)": 0,

            "80TTB": 0,

        }

        deductions["80C"] = (
            input_data["PPF"] + 
            input_data["ELSS"] + 
            input_data["NPS"]["Tier-1 Self Contribution"] +

        )

        health_insurance = sum(hi["Amount"] for hi in input_data["Health Insurance"])
        deductions["80D"] = health_insurance

        deductions["80E"] = input_data["Education Loan Interest"]["Interest Paid"]

        # 80G: Donations
        donations = sum(d["Amount"] for d in input_data["Donations"])
        deductions["80G"] = donations

        # 80TTA: Savings Bank Interest
        deductions["80TTA"] = input_data["Savings Bank Interest"]

        # 80TTB: Deposit Interest
        deductions["80TTB"] = input_data["Deposit Interest"]

        deductions["Total Deductions"] = sum(deductions.values())
        return deductions

    output["Deductions"] = calculate_deductions(input_data)

    def compute_tax(gross_income, deductions, tds):
        taxable_income = gross_income - deductions["Total Deductions"]
        if taxable_income < 0:
            taxable_income = 0

        # Tax slabs for FY 2025-26 (New Regime)
        slabs = [
            (0, 300000, 0),
            (300000, 600000, 0.10),
            (600000, 1200000, 0.15),
            (1200000, 1800000, 0.20),
            (1800000, 2500000, 0.25),
            (2500000, 5000000, 0.30),
            (5000000, float('inf'), 0.30)
        ]

        tax_at_slabs = 0
        taxable = taxable_income
        for slab in slabs:
            lower, upper, rate = slab
            taxable_in_slab = min(upper - lower, taxable - lower)
            if taxable_in_slab < 0:
                continue
            tax_at_slabs += taxable_in_slab * rate

        # Calculate tax on STCG (Section 111A)
        stcg_111a = output["Capital Gains"]["STCG (Section 111A)"]

        ltcg_non_equity = output["Capital Gains"]["LTCG (Non-Equity)"]["Total"]
        tax_ltcg_non_equity = ltcg_non_equity * 0.20

            tax_at_slabs + 
            tax_stcg_111a + 
            tax_stcg_other + 
            tax_ltcg_112a + 
            tax_ltcg_non_equity
        )

        # Rebate under Section 87A
        rebate = 12500 if taxable_income <= 1875000 else 0

        tax_after_rebate = max(0, total_tax_before_rebate - rebate)

        # Surcharge calculation
        surcharge = 0
        if taxable_income > 5000000:
            surcharge = 0.25 * (taxable_income - 5000000)
        elif taxable_income > 2500000:
            surcharge = 0.10 * (taxable_income - 2500000)
        elif taxable_income > 1000000:
            surcharge = 0.15 * (taxable_income - 1000000)

        # Health and Education Cess
        cess = (total_tax_before_rebate + surcharge) * 0.04

        total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + cess

        net_tax_payable = max(0, total_tax_liability - tds)

        return {
            "Tax at Slab Rates": tax_at_slabs,
            "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": tax_stcg_111a,
            "Tax on STCG (Other)": tax_stcg_other,
            "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": tax_ltcg_112a,
            "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": tax_ltcg_non_equity,

            "Tax After Rebate": tax_after_rebate,
            "Surcharge": surcharge,
            "Health and Education Cess": cess,
            "Total Tax Liability": total_tax_liability,
            "Less: TDS": tds,
            "Net Tax Payable / Refund": net_tax_payable
        }

    tax_computation = compute_tax(
        output["Gross Total Income"],
        output["Deductions"],
        input_data["TDS"]
    )
    output["Tax Computation"] = tax_computation

    return output

def main():

def calculate_tax(input_data):

    gross_salary = sum(input_data['Gross Salary'].values())
    exemptions = {
        "Section 10(13A)": 0,
        "Section 10(5)": 0
    }
    section_16_ia = input_data['Professional Tax']
    section_16_ii = 0
    section_16_iii = 0
    net_salary = gross_salary - sum(exemptions.values()) - section_16_ia

    # Capital Gains
    stcg_111a = 0
    stcg_other = {'Bonds': 0, 'Debentures': 0, 'G-Secs': 0, 'Mutual Funds': 0, 'Total': 0}
    ltcg_112a = 0
    ltcg_non_equity = {'Bonds': 0, 'Debentures': 0, 'G-Secs': 0, 'Mutual Funds': 0, 'Total': 0}
    ltcg_other = 0

    for transaction in input_data['Stock Sale Transactions']:
        sale_price = transaction['Sale Price']
        cost_price = transaction['Cost Price']
        quantity = transaction['Quantity']
        gain = (sale_price - cost_price) * quantity
        if (datetime.strptime(transaction['Sale Date'], '%Y-%m-%d') - 
            datetime.strptime(transaction['Purchase Date'], '%Y-%m-%d')).days < 365:
            stcg_111a += gain
        else:
            ltcg_112a += gain

    for mf in input_data['Mutual Fund Transactions']:
        if mf['Type'] == 'equity':
            if (datetime.strptime(mf['Sale Date'], '%Y-%m-%d') - 
                datetime.strptime(mf['Purchase Date'], '%Y-%m-%d')).days < 365:
                stcg_other['Mutual Funds'] += mf['Sale Value'] - mf['Purchase Value']
            else:
                ltcg_non_equity['Mutual Funds'] += mf['Sale Value'] - mf['Purchase Value']

    if input_data['G-Secs']['Sale Amount']:
        gain = input_data['G-Secs']['Sale Amount'] - input_data['G-Secs']['Purchase Amount']
        ltcg_non_equity['G-Secs'] += gain

    # Income from Other Sources
    savings_bank_interest = input_data['Savings Bank Interest']
    deposit_interest = input_data['Deposit Interest']
    other_interest = input_data['Other Interest']
    epf_taxable_interest = input_data['EPF Taxable Interest']

    # Deductions
    deductions = {
        "80C": 0,
        "80CCC": 0,
        "80CCD(1)": 0,
        "80CCD(1B)": 0,
        "80CCD(2)": 0,
        "80D": 0,
        "80E": 0,
        "80G": 0,
        "80TTA": 0,
        "80TTB": 0,
        "Total Deductions": 0
    }

    deductions["80C"] = min(150000, 
                            input_data['PPF'] + 
                            input_data['EPF']['Employee Contribution']['Deducted from Salary'] + 
                            input_data['ELSS'] + 
                            input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Self Contribution'])
    deductions["80CCD(1")] = input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Employer Contribution']
    deductions["80D"] = input_data['Health Insurance'][0]['Amount'] if input_data['Health Insurance'] else 0
    deductions["80E"] = input_data['Education Loan Interest']['Interest Paid']
    deductions["Total Deductions"] = sum(deductions.values())

    # Tax Computation
    taxable_income = net_salary + stcg_111a + sum(stcg_other.values()) + ltcg_112a + sum(ltcg_non_equity.values()) + ltcg_other
    taxable_income += savings_bank_interest + deposit_interest + other_interest + epf_taxable_interest

    tax_at_slab_rates = 0
    if taxable_income > 1500000:
        tax_at_slab_rates = (taxable_income - 1500000) * 0.3
    elif taxable_income > 1200000:
        tax_at_slab_rates = (taxable_income - 1200000) * 0.25
    elif taxable_income > 900000:
        tax_at_slab_rates = (taxable_income - 900000) * 0.2
    elif taxable_income > 600000:
        tax_at_slab_rates = (taxable_income - 600000) * 0.15
    elif taxable_income > 300000:
        tax_at_slab_rates = (taxable_income - 300000) * 0.1
    else:
        tax_at_slab_rates = taxable_income * 0.05

    tax_on_stcg_111a = stcg_111a * 0.15
    tax_on_stcg_other = sum(stcg_other.values()) * max(0, 0.3)
    tax_on_ltcg_112a = ltcg_112a * 0.1
    tax_on_ltcg_non_equity = sum(ltcg_non_equity.values()) * 0.2
    tax_on_ltcg_other = ltcg_other * 0.2

    total_tax_before_rebate = (tax_at_slab_rates + tax_on_stcg_111a + tax_on_stcg_other +
                               tax_on_ltcg_112a + tax_on_ltcg_non_equity + tax_on_ltcg_other)
    rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, 12500) if taxable_income <= 500000 else 0

    output["Tax Computation"]["Net Tax Payable / Refund"] = output["Tax Computation"]["Total Tax Liability"] - input_data["TDS"]

        "Gross Salary": gross_salary,
        "Exemptions": exemptions,
        "Section 16(ia)": section_16_ia,

        "Section 16(iii)": section_16_iii,
        "Net Salary": net_salary
    }
    
    # Capital Gains
    def calculate_capital_gains(transactions, is_stcg):
        gain = 0
        for tx in transactions:
            if is_stcg:
                gain += (tx['Sale Price'] - tx['Cost Price']) * tx['Quantity']
            else:
                gain += max(0, (tx['Sale Value'] - tx['Purchase Value']))
        return gain
    
    stcg_section_111a = 0
    for tx in input_data['Stock Sale Transactions']:
        if (tx['Sale Date'] <= '2025-04-01' and tx['Purchase Date'] >= '2024-04-01') or \
           (tx['Sale Date'] <= '2025-04-01' and tx['Purchase Date'] >= '2024-04-01'):
            stcg_section_111a += (tx['Sale Price'] - tx['Cost Price']) * tx['Quantity']
    
    stcg_other = {
        "Bonds": 0,
        "Debentures": 0,
        "G-Secs": 0,
        "Mutual Funds": 0,
        "Total": 0
    }
    
    ltcg_section_112a = 0
    for tx in input_data['Stock Sale Transactions']:
        if tx['Sale Date'] > '2025-04-01' and tx['Purchase Date'] < '2024-04-01':
            ltcg_section_112a += (tx['Sale Price'] - tx['Cost Price']) * tx['Quantity']
    
    ltcg_non_equity = {
        "Bonds": 0,
        "Debentures": 0,
        "G-Secs": 0,
        "Mutual Funds": 0,
        "Total": 0
    }
    
    ltcg_other = 0
    
    capital_gains = {
        "STCG (Section 111A)": stcg_section_111a,
        "STCG (Other)": stcg_other,
        "LTCG (Section 112A)": ltcg_section_112a,
        "LTCG (Non-Equity)": ltcg_non_equity,
        "LTCG (Other)": ltcg_other
    }
    
    # Income from Other Sources
    other_sources = {
        "Savings Bank Interest": input_data['Savings Bank Interest'],
        "Deposit Interest": input_data['Deposit Interest'],
        "Other Interest": input_data['Other Interest'],
        "EPF Taxable Interest": input_data['EPF Taxable Interest']
    }
    total_other_sources = sum(other_sources.values())
    
    # Gross Total Income
    gross_total_income = under_salaries['Net Salary'] + sum(capital_gains.values()) + total_other_sources
    
    # Deductions
    deductions = {
        "80C": 0,
        "80CCC": 0,
        "80CCD(1)": 0,
        "80CCD(1B)": 0,
        "80CCD(2)": 0,
        "80D": 0,
        "80E": 0,
        "80G": 0,
        "80TTA": 0,
        "80TTB": 0,
        "Total Deductions": 0
    }
    
    # Calculate each deduction
    deductions['80C'] = min(150000, input_data['PPF'] + input_data['ELSS'] + input_data['EPF']['Employee Contribution']['Deducted from Salary'])
    deductions['80CCD(1)'] = input_data['EPF']['Employee Contribution']['Deducted from Salary']
    deductions['80D'] = sum([h['Amount'] for h in input_data['Health Insurance']])
    deductions['80E'] = input_data['Education Loan Interest']['Interest Paid']
    deductions['80G'] = sum([d['Amount'] for d in input_data['Donations']])
    deductions['80TTA'] = input_data['Savings Bank Interest']
    
    deductions['Total Deductions'] = sum(deductions.values())
    
    # Tax Computation
    tax_computation = {
        "Tax at Slab Rates": 0,
        "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": 0,
        "Tax on STCG (Other)": 0,
        "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": 0,
        "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": 0,
        "Tax on LTCG (Other)": 0,
        "Total Tax Before Rebate": 0,
        "Less: Rebate under Section 87A": 0,
        "Tax After Rebate": 0,
        "Surcharge": 0,
        "Health and Education Cess": 0,
        "Total Tax Liability": 0,
        "Less: TDS": input_data['TDS'],
        "Net Tax Payable / Refund": 0
    }
    
    # Calculate tax at slab rates
    taxable_income = gross_total_income - deductions['Total Deductions']
    
    # Slab rates for old regime
    slabs = [
        (300000, 0),
        (600000 - 300001, 5),
        (900000 - 600001, 10),
        (1200000 - 900001, 15),
        (1500000 - 1200001, 20),
        (float('inf'), 25)
    ]
    
    tax_at_slab = 0
    remaining_income = taxable_income
    for slab, rate in slabs:
        if remaining_income <= 0:
            break
        taxable = min(remaining_income, slab)
        tax_at_slab += taxable * (rate / 100)
        remaining_income -= taxable
    
    tax_computation['Tax at Slab Rates'] = tax_at_slab
    
    # Calculate other taxes
    tax_computation['Tax on STCG (Section 111A)'] = stcg_section_111a * 0.15
    tax_computation['Tax on STCG (Other)'] = sum(stcg_other.values()) * 0.15
    tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)'] = ltcg_section_112a * 0.10
    tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)'] = sum(ltcg_non_equity.values()) * 0.20
    
    total_tax_before_rebate = sum([
        tax_computation['Tax at Slab Rates'],
        tax_computation['Tax on STCG (Section 111A)'],
        tax_computation['Tax on STCG (Other)'],
        tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)'],
        tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)'],
        tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Other')]
    ])
    
    tax_computation['Total Tax Before Rebate'] = total_tax_before_rebate
    
    # Rebate under Section 87A
    if taxable_income <= 500000:
        rebate = min(12500, total_tax_before_rebate)
    else:
        rebate = 0
    tax_computation['Less: Rebate under Section 87A'] = rebate
    
    tax_after_rebate = total_tax_before_rebate - rebate
    tax_computation['Tax After Rebate'] = tax_after_rebate
    
    # Surcharge calculation
    if taxable_income > 5000000:
        surcharge = 0.25 * tax_after_rebate
    elif taxable_income > 1000000:
        surcharge = 0.10 * tax_after_rebate
    else:
        surcharge = 0
    tax_computation['Surcharge'] = surcharge
    
    # Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_after_rebate * 0.04
    tax_computation['Health and Education Cess'] = cess
    
    total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + cess
    tax_computation['Total Tax Liability'] = total_tax_liability
    
    # Net tax payable
    net_tax = total_tax_liability - tax_computation['Less: TDS']
    tax_computation['Net Tax Payable / Refund'] = net_tax
    
    # Construct final output
    output = {
        "Under Head Salaries": under_salaries,
        "Capital Gains": capital_gains,
        "Income from Other Sources": other_sources,
        "Gross Total Income": gross_total_income,
        "Deductions": deductions,
        "Total Taxable Income": taxable_income,
        "Tax Computation": tax_computation
    }
    
    return output

def main():
    with open('input.json', 'r') as f:
        input_data = json.load(f)
    output = calculate_tax(input_data)
    print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    elif taxable_income > 1000000:

    elif taxable_income > 2000000:
        surcharge = tax_after_rebate * 0.10
    else:
        surcharge = 0
    tax_computation["Surcharge"] = surcharge
    
    # Calculate Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_after_rebate * 0.04
    tax_computation["Health and Education Cess"] = cess
    
    total_tax_liability = (

        + surcharge
        + cess
    )
    tax_computation["Total Tax Liability"] = total_tax_liability
    
    tax_computation["Less: TDS"] = input_data["TDS"]
    
    net_tax = total_tax_liability - input_data["TDS"]
    tax_computation["Net Tax Payable / Refund"] = net_tax if net_tax > 0 else 0

    return output

import json

def calculate_tax(input_data):
    # Under Head Salaries
    gross_salary = sum(input_data['Gross Salary'].values())
    exemptions = {
        'Section 10(13A)': input_data['Gross Salary']['HRA'],
        'Section 10(5)': input_data['LTA Travel Expenses Claimed']
    }
    section_16 = {
        'Section 16(ia)': input_data['Professional Tax'],
        'Section 16(ii)': input_data['Gross Salary']['Entertainment Allowance'],
        'Section 16(iii)': 0  # Not applicable for government employees
    }
    net_salary = gross_salary - sum(exemptions.values()) - sum(section_16.values())

    # Capital Gains
    stcg_section_111a = 0
    stcg_other = {
        'Bonds': 0,
        'Debentures': 0,
        'G-Secs': 0,
        'Mutual Funds': 0,
        'Total': 0
    }
    ltcg_section_112a = 0
    ltcg_non_equity = {
        'Bonds': 0,
        'Debentures': 0,
        'G-Secs': 0,
        'Mutual Funds': 0,
        'Total': 0
    }
    ltcg_other = 0

    # Calculate capital gains from stock transactions
    for transaction in input_data['Stock Sale Transactions']:
        gain = (transaction['Sale Price'] * transaction['Quantity']) - \
              (transaction['Cost Price'] * transaction['Quantity']) - \
              transaction['Brokerage'] - transaction['STT']
        if gain > 0:
            days_held = (transaction['Sale Date'], transaction['Purchase Date'])
            if days_held < 365:
                stcg_section_111a += gain
            else:
                ltcg_section_112a += gain

    # Calculate capital gains from mutual funds
    for mf in input_data['Mutual Fund Transactions']:
        gain = mf['Sale Value'] - mf['Purchase Value']
        if gain > 0:
            years_held = (mf['Sale Date'], mf['Purchase Date'])
            if years_held >= 3:
                ltcg_section_112a += gain

    # Calculate capital gains from bonds
    bonds_gain = input_data['Bonds']['Sale Amount'] - input_data['Bonds']['Purchase Amount']
    if bonds_gain > 0 and input_data['Bonds']['Held for duration in years'] < 1:
        stcg_other['Bonds'] = bonds_gain

    # Income from Other Sources
    other_sources = {
        'Savings Bank Interest': input_data['Savings Bank Interest'],
        'Deposit Interest': input_data['Deposit Interest'],
        'Other Interest': input_data['Other Interest'],
        'EPF Taxable Interest': input_data['EPF Taxable Interest']
    }

    # Gross Total Income
    gross_total_income = net_salary + stcg_section_111a + ltcg_section_112a + \
                        sum(other_sources.values())

    # Deductions
    deductions = {
        '80C': input_data['PPF'] + input_data['ELSS'],
        '80CCC': input_data['Pension Scheme Premium']['Amount'] / input_data['Pension Scheme Premium']['Number of Years Paid'],
        '80CCD(1)': input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Self Contribution'],
        '80CCD(1B)': input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Employer Contribution'],
        '80CCD(2)': input_data['NPS']['Tier-2'],
        '80D': 0,
        '80E': input_data['Education Loan Interest']['Interest Paid'],
        '80G': input_data['Donations'][0]['Amount'],
        '80TTA': 0,
        '80TTB': 0,
        'Total Deductions': sum(deductions.values())
    }

    # Tax Computation
    taxable_income = gross_total_income - deductions['Total Deductions']
    
    # Calculate tax at slab rates
    tax_slabs = [
        (300000, 0),
        (1200000, 0.20),
        (10000000, 0.25),
        (float('inf'), 0.30)
    ]
    tax_at_slab_rates = 0
    slab_amount = taxable_income
    for limit, rate in tax_slabs:
        if slab_amount > limit:
            tax_at_slab_rates += (slab_amount - limit) * rate
            slab_amount = limit
        else:
            break

    # Calculate other taxes
    tax_on_stcg_section_111a = stcg_section_111a * 0.15
    tax_on_stcg_other = sum(stcg_other.values()) * 0.15
    tax_on_ltcg_section_112a = ltcg_section_112a * 0.10
    tax_on_ltcg_non_equity = sum(ltcg_non_equity.values()) * 0.20

    total_tax_before_rebate = tax_at_slab_rates + tax_on_stcg_section_111a + \
                              tax_on_stcg_other + tax_on_ltcg_section_112a + \
                              tax_on_ltcg_non_equity

    rebate = min(total_tax_before_rebate, 12500) if taxable_income <= 500000 else 0
    tax_after_rebate = total_tax_before_rebate - rebate

    surcharge = 0
    if taxable_income > 5000000:
        surcharge = 0.10 * total_tax_before_rebate

    health_education_cess = total_tax_before_rebate * 0.04

    total_tax_liability = tax_after_rebate + surcharge + health_education_cess
    net_tax_payable = total_tax_liability - input_data['TDS']

    return {
        "Under Head Salaries": {
            "Gross Salary": gross_salary,
            "Exemptions": exemptions,
            "Section 16(ia)": section_16['Section 16(ia)'],
            "Section 16(ii)": section_16['Section 16(ii)'],
            "Section 16(iii)": section_16['Section 16(iii)'],
            "Net Salary": net_salary
        },
        "Capital Gains": {
            "STCG (Section 111A)": stcg_section_111a,
            "STCG (Other)": stcg_other,
            "LTCG (Section 112A)": ltcg_section_112a,
            "LTCG (Non-Equity)": ltcg_non_equity,
            "LTCG (Other)": ltcg_other
        },
        "Income from Other Sources": other_sources,
        "Gross Total Income": gross_total_income,
        "Deductions": deductions,
        "Total Taxable Income": taxable_income,
        "Tax Computation": {
            "Tax at Slab Rates": tax_at_slab_rates,
            "Tax on STCG (Section 111A)": tax_on_stcg_section_111a,
            "Tax on STCG (Other)": tax_on_stcg_other,
            "Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)": tax_on_ltcg_section_112a,
            "Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)": tax_on_ltcg_non_equity,
            "Tax on LTCG (Other)": 0,
            "Total Tax Before Rebate": total_tax_before_rebate,
            "Less: Rebate under Section 87A": rebate,
            "Tax After Rebate": tax_after_rebate,
            "Surcharge": surcharge,
            "Health and Education Cess": health_education_cess,
            "Total Tax Liability": total_tax_liability,
            "Less: TDS": input_data['TDS'],
            "Net Tax Payable / Refund": net_tax_payable
        }
    }

def main():
    with open('input.json', 'r') as f:
        input_data = json.load(f)
    output = calculate_tax(input_data)
    print(json.dumps(output))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

                if tx['FMV as of 31 Jan 2018'] > 0:
                    gain = min(sale_price, tx['FMV as of 31 Jan 2018']) - cost_price
                    gain = gain * quantity
                else:
                    gain = (sale_price - cost_price) * quantity
                gain -= total_expenses
            else:
                # STCG calculation
                gain = (sale_price - cost_price) * quantity
                gain -= total_expenses
            
            gains.append(gain)
        
        return sum(gains)

    tax_on_ltcg_112a = capital_gains['LTCG (Section 112A)] * 0.1

        surcharge = 0.15
    elif taxable_income > 500000:
        surcharge = 0.1
    else:

    surcharge_amount = tax_after_rebate * surcharge

    cess = tax_after_rebate * 0.04

    # TDS and Net Tax
    net_tax_payable = total_tax_liability - input_data['TDS']
    
    tax_computation = {
        'Tax at Slab Rates': tax_at_slabs,
        'Tax on STCG (Section 111A)': tax_on_stcg_111a,
        'Tax on STCG (Other)': tax_on_stcg_other,
        'Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)': tax_on_ltcg_112a,
        'Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)': tax_on_ltcg_non_equity,
        'Tax on LTCG (Other)': tax_on_ltcg_other,
        'Total Tax Before Rebate': total_tax_before_rebate,

        'Surcharge': surcharge_amount,
        'Health and Education Cess': cess,
        'Total Tax Liability': total_tax_liability,
        'Less: TDS': input_data['TDS'],
        'Net Tax Payable / Refund': net_tax_payable
    }
    
    # Construct final output
    output = {
        'Under Head Salaries': under_salaries,
        'Capital Gains': capital_gains,
        'Income from Other Sources': other_sources,
        'Gross Total Income': gross_total_income,
        'Deductions': deductions,
        'Total Taxable Income': taxable_income,
        'Tax Computation': tax_computation
    }
    
    return output

def main():

import json
from datetime import datetime

def calculate_tax(input_data):
    # Under Head Salaries
    gross_salary = sum(input_data['Gross Salary'].values())
    
    # Exemptions
    exemptions = {
        'Section 10(13A)': input_data['Gross Salary']['HRA'] if input_data['City'] == 'metro' else 0,
        'Section 10(5)': input_data['LTA Travel Expenses Claimed']
    }
    
    # Deductions under Section 16
    section_16 = {
        'Section 16(ia)': input_data['Professional Tax'],
        'Section 16(ii)': 0,  # Entertainment allowance is fully taxable
        'Section 16(iii)': 0  # No other deductions specified
    }
    
    net_salary = gross_salary - sum(exemptions.values()) - sum(section_16.values())
    
    # Capital Gains
    capital_gains = {
        'STCG (Section 111A)': 0,
        'STCG (Other)': {'Bonds': 0, 'Debentures': 0, 'G-Secs': 0, 'Mutual Funds': 0, 'Total': 0},
        'LTCG (Section 112A)': 0,
        'LTCG (Non-Equity)': {'Bonds': 0, 'Debentures': 0, 'G-Secs': 0, 'Mutual Funds': 0, 'Total': 0},
        'LTCG (Other)': 0
    }
    
    for transaction in input_data['Stock Sale Transactions']:
        sale_price = transaction['Sale Price']
        cost_price = transaction['Cost Price']
        quantity = transaction['Quantity']
        brokerage = transaction['Brokerage']
        stt = transaction['STT']
        purchase_date = datetime.strptime(transaction['Purchase Date'], '%Y-%m-%d')
        sale_date = datetime.strptime(transaction['Sale Date'], '%Y-%m-%d')
        holding_period = (sale_date - purchase_date).days
        
        gain = (sale_price - cost_price) * quantity - brokerage - stt
        
        if holding_period < 366:  # Short-term
            if stt > 0:
                capital_gains['STCG (Section 111A)]'] += gain
        else:  # Long-term
            if stt > 0:
                capital_gains['LTCG (Section 112A)'] += max(gain, (sale_price - max(cost_price, transaction['FMV as of 31 Jan 2018'])) * quantity - brokerage - stt)
    
    # G-Secs
    g_sec_gain = input_data['G-Secs']['Sale Amount'] - input_data['G-Secs']['Purchase Amount']
    if input_data['G-Secs']['Held for duration in years'] > 1:
        capital_gains['LTCG (Non-Equity)']['G-Secs'] = g_sec_gain
    
    # Income from Other Sources
    other_sources = {
        'Savings Bank Interest': input_data['Savings Bank Interest'],
        'Deposit Interest': input_data['Deposit Interest'],
        'Other Interest': input_data['Other Interest'],
        'EPF Taxable Interest': input_data['EPF Taxable Interest']
    }
    
    # Deductions
    deductions = {
        '80C': 0,
        '80CCC': 0,
        '80CCD(1)': 0,
        '80CCD(1B)': 0,
        '80CCD(2)': 0,
        '80D': 0,
        '80E': 0,
        '80G': 0,
        '80TTA': 0,
        '80TTB': 0,
        'Total Deductions': 0
    }
    
    # 80C
    deductions['80C'] = (input_data['EPF']['Employee Contribution']['Deducted from Salary'] +
                         input_data['PPF'] +
                         input_data['ELSS'])
    deductions['80C'] = min(deductions['80C'], 150000)
    
    # 80CCD(1)
    deductions['80CCD(1)'] = min(input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Self Contribution'], 150000)
    
    # 80CCD(1B)
    deductions['80CCD(1B)'] = min(input_data['NPS']['Tier-1 Self Contribution'], 50000)
    
    # 80D
    health_premiums = sum([h['Amount'] for h in input_data['Health Insurance']])
    deductions['80D'] = min(health_premiums, 75000)
    
    # 80G
    deductions['80G'] = sum([d['Amount'] for d in input_data['Donations']])
    
    # 80TTA
    deductions['80TTA'] = min(input_data['Savings Bank Interest'], 10000)
    
    # Total Deductions
    deductions['Total Deductions'] = sum(deductions.values())
    
    # Gross Total Income
    gross_total_income = net_salary + sum(other_sources.values()) + sum(capital_gains.values())
    
    # Tax Computation
    tax_computation = {
        'Tax at Slab Rates': 0,
        'Tax on STCG (Section 111A)': 0,
        'Tax on STCG (Other)': 0,
        'Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)': 0,
        'Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)': 0,
        'Tax on LTCG (Other)': 0,
        'Total Tax Before Rebate': 0,
        'Less: Rebate under Section 87A': 0,
        'Tax After Rebate': 0,
        'Surcharge': 0,
        'Health and Education Cess': 0,
        'Total Tax Liability': 0,
        'Less: TDS': input_data['TDS'],
        'Net Tax Payable / Refund': 0
    }
    
    # Calculate tax at slab rates
    taxable_income = gross_total_income - deductions['Total Deductions']
    
    if taxable_income > 3000000:
        tax = (taxable_income - 2500000) * 0.3
        tax += (2500000 - 1200000) * 0.25
        tax += (1200000 - 300000) * 0.2
        tax += 300000 * 0
    elif taxable_income > 1200000:
        tax = (taxable_income - 1200000) * 0.25
        tax += (1200000 - 300000) * 0.2
        tax += 300000 * 0
    elif taxable_income > 300000:
        tax = (taxable_income - 300000) * 0.2
        tax += 300000 * 0
    else:
        tax = 0
    
    tax_computation['Tax at Slab Rates'] = tax
    
    # Calculate other taxes
    tax_computation['Tax on STCG (Section 111A)'] = capital_gains['STCG (Section 111A)'] * 0.15
    tax_computation['Tax on STCG (Other)'] = sum(capital_gains['STCG (Other)'].values()) * 0.15
    tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)'] = max(capital_gains['LTCG (Section 112A)]'] - 100000, 0) * 0.1
    tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)'] = sum(capital_gains['LTCG (Non-Equity)'].values()) * 0.2
    
    tax_computation['Total Tax Before Rebate'] = sum([
        tax_computation['Tax at Slab Rates'],
        tax_computation['Tax on STCG (Section 111A)'],
        tax_computation['Tax on STCG (Other)'],
        tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Section 112A)'],
        tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Non-Equity)'],
        tax_computation['Tax on LTCG (Other')]
    ])
    
    # Rebate under Section 87A
    if taxable_income <= 500000:
        rebate = 12500
    else:
        rebate = 0
    tax_computation['Less: Rebate under Section 87A'] = rebate
    
    tax_computation['Tax After Rebate'] = tax_computation['Total Tax Before Rebate'] - rebate
    
    # Surcharge
    if taxable_income > 5000000:
        surcharge = tax_computation['Tax After Rebate'] * 0.25
    elif taxable_income > 10000000:
        surcharge = tax_computation['Tax After Rebate'] * 0.15
    elif taxable_income > 20000000:
        surcharge = tax_computation['Tax After Rebate'] * 0.10
    else:
        surcharge = 0
    tax_computation['Surcharge'] = surcharge
    
    # Health and Education Cess
    tax_computation['Health and Education Cess'] = (tax_computation['Tax After Rebate'] + surcharge) * 0.04
    
    tax_computation['Total Tax Liability'] = (tax_computation['Tax After Rebate'] + surcharge + 
                                           tax_computation['Health and Education Cess'])
    
    tax_computation['Net Tax Payable / Refund'] = tax_computation['Total Tax Liability'] - tax_computation['Less: TDS']
    
    return {
        "Under Head Salaries": {
            "Gross Salary": gross_salary,
            "Exemptions": exemptions,
            "Section 16(ia)": section_16['Section 16(ia)'],
            "Section 16(ii)": section_16['Section 16(ii)'],
            "Section 16(iii)": section_16['Section 16(iii)'],
            "Net Salary": net_salary
        },
        "Capital Gains": capital_gains,
        "Income from Other Sources": other_sources,
        "Gross Total Income": gross_total_income,
        "Deductions": deductions,
        "Total Taxable Income": taxable_income,
        "Tax Computation": tax_computation
    }

def main():
    with open('input.json', 'r') as f:
        input_data = json.load(f)
    output = calculate_tax(input_data)
    print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

    tax_at_slab = 0

    for limit, rate in slab_rates:

        remaining -= taxable
        if remaining <= 0:

    tax_computation["Tax at Slab Rates"] = tax_at_slab

    )

    tax_computation["Net Tax Payable / Refund"] = tax_computation["Total Tax Liability"] - tax_computation["Less: TDS"]

    gross_salary = sum(input_data['Gross Salary'].values())
    
    # Exemptions
    exemption_10_13a = 0  # Since HRA is provided
    exemption_10_5 = input_data['LTA Travel Expenses Claimed']
    
    # Deductions under Section 16
    section_16_ia = input_data['Professional Tax']
    section_16_ii = 0  # Not applicable under new regime
    section_16_iii = 0  # Not applicable under new regime
    
    net_salary = gross_salary - (exemption_10_13a + exemption_10_5) - (section_16_ia + section_16_ii + section_16_iii)
    
    # Capital Gains
    stcg_111a = 0
    stcg_other = {'Bonds': 0, 'Debentures': 0, 'G-Secs': 0, 'Mutual Funds': 0, 'Total': 0}
    ltcg_112a = 0
    ltcg_non_equity = {'Bonds': 0, 'Debentures': 0, 'G-Secs': 0, 'Mutual Funds': 0, 'Total': 0}
    ltcg_other = 0
    
    for transaction in input_data['Stock Sale Transactions']:
        sale_price = transaction['Sale Price']
        cost_price = transaction['Cost Price']
        quantity = transaction['Quantity']
        brokerage = transaction['Brokerage']
        stt = transaction['STT']
        
        gain = (sale_price * quantity) - (cost_price * quantity) - brokerage - stt
        
        purchase_date = datetime.strptime(transaction['Purchase Date'], '%Y-%m-%d')
        sale_date = datetime.strptime(transaction['Sale Date'], '%Y-%m-%d')
        holding_days = (sale_date - purchase_date).days
        
        if holding_days < 365:
            # Short-term gain
            stcg_111a += gain
        else:
            # Long-term gain
            ltcg_other += gain
    
    # Applying losses
    for loss in input_data['Long Term Capital Loss']:
        ltcg_other -= loss['Loss Amount']
    
    # Income from Other Sources

    # Tax Computation
    taxable_income = gross_total_income - deductions['Total Deductions']
